bio: Jalal Khan is a licensed Mortgage Broker at Vancouver Mortgage Solutions (VMS), described on the site as a boutique broker experience. The site lists first-time buyer, home financing, private, bruised credit, reverse and refinance mortgages. A second broker, Noel Giborees, is listed on the about page.
tagline: Future-Ready Mortgage Solutions for Your Perfect Home
